title: Stealth fighter panels rumored to be anti-gravity

tellings.quote: people go in and pull panels out of it and put them in briefcases and go away. And he said the rumor was that some of those were anti-gravity just to help it fly in a different way

plain: People are said to go into an Air Force stealth fighter, pull panels out of it, put them in briefcases and leave, and the rumour was that some of those panels were anti-gravity, a means of cancelling gravity, to help the plane fly in a different way. The writer Greg Bishop tells Michels this as he heard it from a man he does not name. If true, technology beyond known physics would already be flying inside military aircraft.
